2115017987883229637.en_summary: Mercedes is hit hard by the China shock, joining BMW and VW in cutting outlook to car margin of just 2–3% from up to 5%. Shares tumble 5.4%, year's loss more than a third. Germany’s Big Three worth just €106bn combined. Tesla alone worth €1.4tn, more than 13 times as much. China once profit engine now major liability.
